description.value:
Traits Paradise-Touched, divination

You are continuously aware of every creature within 1 mile that is currently in contact with Paradise — casting a Paradise-Touched effect, using a Glimpse, listening to the Feed, or being spoken to by it. You know how many there are and roughly where each is, to within a few hundred feet and a compass direction. You do not learn who they are, what Aperture they use, or what they are asking. This cannot be switched off.
